items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Russell's band had changed musicians considerably... Lee Blaire played guitar.

ctx.x: Russell's band had changed musicians considerably. Paul Barbarin had come back from New Orleans, Pops Foster was still in the band and I had rejoined it. The other two trumpets were Bobby Cheeks and John Brown. The sax
section consisted of Glyn Pague and Henry 'Moon' Jones on altos, Bingie Madison tenor. Jimmy Arckey was still there on trombone and Lee Blaire played guitar.

'Snake-Hips' Tucker was a tough guy and loved to fight. When he did his number the customers would throw dollar bills on the floor just to see him do a summersault and go into a split to pick them up. One night a table of college guys were with some girls and one of these fellows heated a half-dollar and threw it on the floor.
